The texture of the snake is uniformly smooth, lacking the slight irregularities of real skin/scales, suggesting a minor 'texture anomaly' (AI smoothing). These are low-severity issues (1-2) but were missed by the Router's binary artifact check.
alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'thunder snake' class. The fine-grained classifier confirmed the species with high confidence (Top-1 logit 7.6). Key morphological features (blunt head, worm-like body, uniform color) are present. The score is deducted slightly because the eye detail is ambiguous and the scale texture is overly smooth/plastic compared to high-fidelity biological references, reducing the 'fine-grained' realism.

The perceptual auditor's 'compression' finding is likely misidentifying this slight AI-smoothing/noise pattern. These minor textural and boundary imperfections prevent a perfect artifact score.
